# Collect album library song_ids and build a global unique set + any song metadata we may already have

creds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
spotify_pw = next(c['password'] for c in creds if c['account_name']=='spotify')
spotify_login = apis.spotify.login(username='chrharrison@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw)
access_token = spotify_login['access_token']

# Start by re-fetching song library metadata for mapping song_id -> (title, artists_str)
song_meta = {}  # song_id -> (title, artists_str)
song_ids_all = set()

page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=access_token, query='', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('song_library page', page_index, 'count', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    for s in page:
        sid = s['song_id']
        song_ids_all.add(sid)
        artists_str = '|'.join([a['name'] for a in s.get('artists', [])])
        song_meta[sid] = (s.get('title', ''), artists_str)
    page_index += 1

print('song_library unique songs:', len(song_ids_all))

# Album library
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
album_songs_added = 0
while True:
    albums_page = apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=access_token, query='', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('album_library page', page_index, 'count', len(albums_page))
    if not albums_page:
        break
    for alb in albums_page:
        for sid in alb.get('song_ids', []):
            if sid not in song_ids_all:
                album_songs_added += 1
            song_ids_all.add(sid)
    page_index += 1

print('total unique songs after album library:', len(song_ids_all), 'new from albums:', album_songs_added)

arguments.code:
# Export unique songs from (song library + album library + playlists) into ~/backups/spotify_songs.csv

import io, csv

# Re-login Spotify and File System for fresh tokens
creds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
spotify_pw = next(c['password'] for c in creds if c['account_name']=='spotify')
fs_pw = next(c['password'] for c in creds if c['account_name']=='file_system')

spotify_login = apis.spotify.login(username='chrharrison@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw)
access_token = spotify_login['access_token']

fs_login = apis.file_system.login(username='chrharrison@gmail.com', password=fs_pw)
fs_access_token = fs_login['access_token']

# song_ids_all and song_meta may not exist in this fresh execution context; rebuild from scratch
song_ids_all = set()
song_meta = {}  # sid -> (title, artists_str)

# Song library
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=access_token, query='', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('song_library page', page_index, 'count', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    for s in page:
        sid = s['song_id']
        song_ids_all.add(sid)
        artists_str = '|'.join([a['name'] for a in s.get('artists', [])])
        song_meta[sid] = (s.get('title', ''), artists_str)
    page_index += 1

# Album library
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    albums_page = apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=access_token, query='', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('album_library page', page_index, 'count', len(albums_page))
    if not albums_page:
        break
    for alb in albums_page:
        for sid in alb.get('song_ids', []):
            song_ids_all.add(sid)
    page_index += 1

# Playlists (public + private)
all_playlist_song_ids = set()
for is_public in [True, False]:
    page_index = 0
    page_limit = 20
    while True:
        pl_page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, query='', is_public=is_public, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        print('playlist_library is_public', is_public, 'page', page_index, 'count', len(pl_page))
        if not pl_page:
            break
        for pl in pl_page:
            for sid in pl.get('song_ids', []):
                all_playlist_song_ids.add(sid)
        page_index += 1

union_song_ids = sorted(song_ids_all.union(all_playlist_song_ids))
print('unique song_ids union count:', len(union_song_ids))

# Fetch missing metadata via show_song
missing = [sid for sid in union_song_ids if sid not in song_meta]
print('missing metadata count:', len(missing))

for idx, sid in enumerate(missing):
    details = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    title = details.get('title', '')
    artists_str = '|'.join([a['name'] for a in details.get('artists', [])])
    song_meta[sid] = (title, artists_str)
    if (idx+1) % 10 == 0:
        print('fetched', idx+1, 'of', len(missing))

# Ensure destination dir
apis.file_system.create_directory(directory_path='~/backups', access_token=fs_access_token, recursive=True, allow_if_exists=True)

# Build CSV content
output = io.StringIO()
writer = csv.writer(output)
writer.writerow(['Title', 'Artists'])

for sid in union_song_ids:
    title, artists_str = song_meta.get(sid, ('', ''))
    writer.writerow([title, artists_str])

content = output.getvalue()
print('csv bytes:', len(content))

# Write file (overwrite)
res = apis.file_system.create_file(file_path='~/backups/spotify_songs.csv', access_token=fs_access_token, content=content, overwrite=True)
print('create_file_res:', res)

# Logout Spotify (optional)
try:
    apis.spotify.logout(access_token=access_token)
except Exception as e:
    print('spotify_logout_error:', str(e)[:200])

# Delete Spotify account after backup
# Need access token again (account deletion requires spotify access token). Re-login.
spotify_login2 = apis.spotify.login(username='chrharrison@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw)
access_token2 = spotify_login2['access_token']

delete_res = apis.spotify.delete_account(access_token=access_token2)
print('delete_account_res:', delete_res)
